They intended to share illegal profits and paid bribe 200,000 yuan to the official. This sounds like bribery (行贿) and possibly abuse of power, corruption, maybe "受贿" (receiving bribe) but the defendant is the company and its legal representative paying bribe, so they are the bribe givers: "行贿". That is bribery (行贿). Also possibly "滥用职权" for the official, but the official is not a defendant here. The defendant is the company and its legal representative. So charge: 行贿.
